source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 76 — THE TWELVE GATES OF THE FOUR WINDS (3 per cardinal direction). **4Q210 ('Astronomical Enochc,' early/mid 1st c. BCE) preserves substantial parallel material for chs 76-77** — the four-corners-of-earth + winds geography. This is one of the better-attested chapters in the Aramaic stratum. CROSS-CORPUS: foundational cosmological-meteorology — feeds Rev 7:1 (four angels at four corners restraining four winds); cf. Zech 6:5 (four winds of heaven); cf. Dan 7:2 (four winds stirring the great sea).

verses.text_geez: ወበአፍላገ፡ ምድር፡ ርእኩ፡ ዐሠርተ፡ ወክልኤተ፡ አናቅጸ፡ ክሥቱተ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ነፋሳት፡ እመኔሆሙ፡ ይወፅኡ፡ ነፋሳት፡ ወይነፍሑ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
verses.text_aramaic: ובאפי ארעא חזית עשרה ותרין תרעין פתיחין לכל רוחיא דמנהון נפקין רוחיא ונשבין על ארעא
verses.translit: u-ba-ʾappē ʾarʿāʾ ḥăzēt ʿaśrāh u-tĕrēn tarʿīn pětīḥīn lě-kol rūḥayyāʾ dī minhōn nāpĕqīn rūḥayyāʾ wě-nāšbīn ʿal ʾarʿāʾ
verses.text_geez: ወበአፍላገ፡ ምድር፡ ርእኩ፡ ዐሠርተ፡ ወክልኤተ፡ አናቅጸ፡ ክሥቱተ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ነፋሳት፡ እመኔሆሙ፡ ይወፅኡ፡ ነፋሳት፡ ወይነፍሑ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q210 frag 1 col. ii lines 16-20 preserves substantial Aramaic parallel (Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 pp. 162-167; Drawnel 2011 pp. 286-295)
verses.notes: **THE TWELVE WIND-GATES at the ends of the earth.** 4Q210 is one of the most-preserved Aramaic witnesses for this chapter. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Zech 6:5 (four chariots = four winds of heaven going forth from before YHWH); cf. Dan 7:2 ('the four winds of heaven stirred up the great sea'); cf. Rev 7:1 ('four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds'). The 12-gate structure (3 per cardinal direction) is distinctive to the Astronomical Book.

verses.text_geez: ሠለስቱ፡ እሙንቱ፡ በምሥራቅ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወሠለስቱ፡ በምዕራብ፡ ወሠለስቱ፡ በየማን፡ ሰማይ፡ ወሠለስቱ፡ በፀጋም፡
verses.text_aramaic: תלתא אנון במדנח שמיא ותלתא במערב ותלתא בימינא דשמיא ותלתא בשמאלא
verses.translit: tělātāʾ ʾinnōn bě-madnāḥ šĕmayyāʾ ū-tělātāʾ bě-maʿărāb ū-tělātāʾ bě-yāminā dī-šĕmayyāʾ ū-tělātāʾ bi-śĕmālāʾ
verses.text_geez: ሠለስቱ፡ እሙንቱ፡ በምሥራቅ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወሠለስቱ፡ በምዕራብ፡ ወሠለስቱ፡ በየማን፡ ሰማይ፡ ወሠለስቱ፡ በፀጋም፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q210 frag 1 col. ii lines 18-20 (Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 p. 167)
verses.notes: **3+3+3+3 = 12: three gates per cardinal direction.** Note the Aramaic uses YAMIN/SEMAL ('right/left' = south/north when oriented to the rising sun). Standard Semitic cardinal-orientation. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Rev 21:13 (3 gates of New Jerusalem per cardinal direction).

verses.text_geez: ወቀዳሚሁ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ዘጎ፡ ሰሜን፡ ዘይትለዐል፡ ወዘይከውን፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቍር፡ ወአስሐትዮት፡ ወድካም፡ ወአሕማም፡ ወሐዘን፡
verses.translit: wa-qadāmihu ʾəmənnehomu zago samēn zayətlaʿʿal wa-zayəkawwən lāʿlēhu manfas qwər wa-ʾasḥātyot wa-dəkām wa-ʾaḥmām wa-ḥazan
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic 4Q210 frag 1 col. ii line 20+ fragmentary
verses.notes: **The north-wind brings cold, hail (or frost), fatigue, sickness, sorrow.** Climatological associations begin. Cross-corpus: Prov 25:23 ('the north wind brings forth rain'); Job 37:9, 22 ('out of the north comes golden splendor'). Note the negative valence assigned to the north.

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ መንገል፡ ካዕብቱ፡ ዘበማእክለ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ዘፍሥሓ፡ ወዘጥዕና፡ ወዘጠል፡ ወዘዝናም፡ ወዘስብእ፡ ወዘበረከት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmənna mangal kāʿbətu zabamāʾəkla yəwaḍḍəʾ zafəśśəḥā wa-zaṭəʿnā wa-zaṭall wa-zazənām wa-zasəbʾ wa-zabarakat
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic not preserved at this verse
verses.notes: Middle north-gate: joy, health, dew, rain, prosperity, blessing.

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ ካልዕ፡ መንገል፡ ይወፅኡ፡ ንዋማት፡ ወዕርፍት፡ ወምሕረት፡ ወሕይወት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmənna kāləʿ mangal yəwaḍḍəʾu nəwāmāt wa-ʿərft wa-məḥrat wa-ḥəywat
verses.notes: Third (southern) of the three north-gates: sleep, rest, mercy, life.

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ሰማይ፡ ዘሠለስቱ፡ አናቅጽ፡ ቀዳማይ፡ ዘይትለዐል፡ ጾታሁ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ እምኔሁ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ጠል፡ ወዝናም፡ ወአንበጣ፡ ወድካም፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmənna məśrāq samāy zaśallastu ʾanāqəḍ qadāmāyə zayətlaʿʿal ṣotahu mangala samēn ʾəmənnehu yəwaḍḍəʾ ṭall wa-zənām wa-ʾanbaṭā wa-dəkām
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic 4Q210 frag 1 col. iii preserves partial parallel (Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 p. 167)
verses.notes: **East gates begin** — northernmost east-gate: dew, rain, locust, fatigue. Locust-association anticipates Joel 1-2.

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ መንገል፡ ካዕብ፡ ዘበማእክል፡ ዘይወፅእ፡ ብርሃን፡ ወዝናም፡ ወጠል፡ ወሐይል፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmənna mangal kāʿb zabamāʾəkəl zayəwaḍḍəʾ bərhān wa-zənām wa-ṭall wa-ḥayl
verses.notes: Middle east-gate (the equinoctial direction): light, rain, dew, strength.

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ መንገል፡ ካልዕ፡ ይወፅእ፡ መንፈስ፡ ሞቅ፡ ወድርቅ፡ ወሕማም፡ ወማዕታት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmənna mangal kāləʿ yəwaḍḍəʾ manfas moq wa-dərq wa-ḥəmām wa-māʿtāt
verses.notes: Southernmost east-gate: heat, drought, sickness, death.

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ አናቅጽ፡ ዘበየማን፡ ሰማይ፡ ቀዳማይ፡ ዘጎ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ይወፅእ፡ መንፈስ፡ ሞቅ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmənna śallastu ʾanāqəḍ zaba-yamān samāy qadāmāyə zago məśrāq yəwaḍḍəʾ manfas moq

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ መንገል፡ ካዕብ፡ ዘጎ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ጠል፡ ወዝናም፡ ወአንበጣ፡ ወድካም፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmənna mangal kāʿb zago yəwaḍḍəʾ ṭall wa-zənām wa-ʾanbaṭā wa-dəkām
verses.notes: Middle south-gate: dew, rain, locust, fatigue. (Same paired-association as 76:6, an apparent textual issue Charles 1912 flagged.)

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ መንገል፡ ሣልስ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ዘጎ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ጠል፡ ወዝናም፡ ወአንበጣ፡ ወድካም፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmənna mangal śāləs yəwaḍḍəʾ zago məʿrāb ṭall wa-zənām wa-ʾanbaṭā wa-dəkām
verses.notes: Third south-gate (west-facing). Ge'ez here is noted by Charles 1912 as textually problematic; multiple verses repeat similar association-strings, suggesting scribal corruption.

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ሰማይ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ አናቅጽ፡ ቀዳማይ፡ ዘጎ፡ ሰሜን፡ እምኔሁ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ጠል፡ ወዝናም፡ ወጾታ፡ ወማዕታት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmənna məʿrāb samāy śallastu ʾanāqəḍ qadāmāyə zago samēn ʾəmənnehu yəwaḍḍəʾ ṭall wa-zənām wa-ṣotā wa-māʿtāt
verses.notes: **West gates begin.** First west-gate: dew, rain, hoarfrost, death.

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ መንገል፡ ካዕብ፡ ዘበማእክል፡ ይወፅእ፡ ዝናም፡ ወጠል፡ ወሕይወት፡ ወበረከት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmənna mangal kāʿb zabamāʾəkəl yəwaḍḍəʾ zənām wa-ṭall wa-ḥəywat wa-barakat
verses.notes: Middle west-gate: rain, dew, life, blessing.

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ መንገል፡ ሣልስ፡ ዘጎ፡ ጾታ፡ ይወፅእ፡ መንፈስ፡ ድሙት፡ ወቍር፡ ወድካም፡ ወሐዘን፡ ወዘንቱ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለነፋሳት፡ ዘይነፍሑ፡ ዘይኬልሉ፡ እምነ፡ አርባዕቱ፡ ማእዘን፡ ለሰማይ፡ ኮኑ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmənna mangal śāləs zago ṣotā yəwaḍḍəʾ manfas dəmut wa-qwər wa-dəkām wa-ḥazan wa-zantu ḫolaqomu la-nafāsāt zayənafāḥu zayəkēlalu ʾəmənna ʾarbāʿtu māʾəzan la-samāy konu ḫolaqomu
verses.notes: **SUMMARY CLOSING: 12 wind-gates from the 4 corners of heaven complete.** Third west-gate: silence, cold, fatigue, sorrow. **CROSS-CORPUS**: 'four corners of heaven' (māʾəzan) — cf. Isa 11:12 (gather from the four corners of the earth); cf. Rev 7:1 ('four angels at the four corners').
